failures.assertion: Removes the `section:nth-child(2n)` rule and explains that it never matches in Marp; any dark slides use a `<!-- _class: ... -->` directive with a matching `section.<name>` rule.
failures.evidence: Although the replacement uses “<!-- _class: dark -->” with “section.dark”, the explanation says the original selector “does not select alternate slides reliably” rather than explaining that it never matches in Marp.

failures.assertion: The PDF export command includes `--pdf` and `--allow-local-files`, with the reason that local photos are otherwise blank.
failures.evidence: The PDF command includes "--allow-local-files calm-interfaces.md" and "-o build/calm-interfaces.pdf" but omits "--pdf", and the output does not explain that local photos are otherwise blank.

failures.assertion: Warns that these commands never exit and would block an agent shell if run in the foreground, so it starts it in the background or gives the user the command to run.
failures.evidence: The output says "without blocking the agent shell" and backgrounds the process, but never explicitly warns that these commands never exit or that foreground execution would block the shell.

failures.assertion: Says the image conversion needs Chrome, Edge or Firefox.
failures.evidence: The output says "The JPEG command requires a browser," but does not name Chrome, Edge or Firefox.

failures.assertion: States the slide count it chose for the 10-minute slot and calls it a rule of thumb, not a Marp requirement.
failures.evidence: The output states "10 slides for 10 minutes" but never calls that count a rule of thumb or distinguishes it from a Marp requirement.
The output includes "/* @theme my-theme */" rather than the specified "/* @theme name */" metadata comment.
